title: F169.4 flat has no depth: a visitor talks to Orbi on a flat page
caption: Each piece of the talk asks the surface tool, the tool asks the theme, and flat answers with a line or with none. The picture in the answer is the engine's, and wears flat's own rules.

steps.text: opens Orbi and clicks in the typing row
a hairline inside the edge, and none
the row: its violet line and pale ring, no shadow, no blur
press-shadow() on the send, spoken() on the message  (steps 4, 5)
none, none, and the message's own colour  (step 5)
shimmer() on the line that says Orbi is working  (step 8)
the words' own grey: nothing is seen to move
the small ring beside the words still turns
the answer holds a picture: draw it for a page
its copy, with flat's rules: no glow, one violet rail  (steps 6, 7)
the answer: a code block with a line round it, and the picture
